content.thinking: The nested class got mangled. Let me just remove the nested class and throw `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException` (java.lang) directly.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission/src/offline && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='ReceiveAudit.java'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("    private static final class ArrayArrayIndexOutOfBounds extends ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException {}\n\n","")
s=s.replace("throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBounds();","throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException();")
s=s.replace("catch (ArrayIndexOutOfBounds error)","catch (ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException error)")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 build.py /workspace/submission/src /workspace/tmp/classes 2>&1 | head -40
